objection.quote: So it suffices: $S_\infty$ is a union of residue classes mod $L$ (then $a_{n+T}=a_n+L$ for ALL $n$ with $T=\#(S_\infty\cap[1,L])$).
objection.witness: The write-up must establish an actual finite $L$ and prove membership invariance under $m\mapsto m+L$ for every $m\ge a_1$, then derive the indexing shift from the first term. The quote gives only a conditional assembly under the unproved assumption that $S_\infty$ is a union of residue classes.
objection.load_bearing: The desired conclusion follows only after the unproved residue-class hypothesis is established globally. Numerical verification and conditional language do not prove periodicity from $n=1$.
